title: Fastify adapter
objective: Nest's Fastify adapter must be provided explicitly when the teaching app promises Fastify behavior.
misconception: The app uses Nest's default HTTP platform even though tests expect Fastify.
acceptance: Start the real application, inspect its adapter type and issue a GET /health request.
securityBoundary: Keep the example loopback-only; do not expose its unauthenticated endpoints publicly.
